hero.title: A full-service CPA firm for business owners, executives and independent professionals.
hero.lead: We offer a broad range of accounting, tax and advisory services from one office on Rollingbrook Drive. Call us today and we will be happy to offer you a free initial consultation.
hero.imageAlt: A calculator resting on financial statements on a desk

overview.title: Accounting, tax and advisory work for individuals and for the businesses that employ them.
overview.text: Pick a service to see what it covers, or call the office and talk it through with our team. Pricing is quoted by phone.

services.title: Tax Preparation
services.text: Today's tax laws are complicated enough that a relatively simple return can be confusing, and it is easy to overlook deductions and credits you are entitled to.
services.lead: Preparing your own return can leave you with more questions than answers. Even with a software package there is no substitute for an experienced tax professional reading your situation.
services.imageAlt: Tax withholding publications, forms and a calculator laid out on a table

covers.title: Checked and rechecked
covers.text: Your return is run against our software to identify the items the IRS may look at more closely and to review the math, which limits contact from the IRS.

covers.title: Electronic filing
covers.text: Your return can be filed electronically so a refund comes back quicker.

covers.title: Withholding review
covers.text: We show you how to adjust your payroll withholding so you keep more of each paycheck instead of lending the IRS money interest-free.

covers.title: Next year's deductions
covers.text: We point out deductions that will lower next year's liability, and give you a sheet of the ones most commonly overlooked.

covers.title: Books a mess? No problem
covers.text: If you own a small business and have not kept up the bookkeeping, we will prepare the year's books, a full Schedule C and your personal return, then set up a system you can keep up with.

questions.q: Do you prepare business returns as well as personal ones?
questions.a: Yes. The firm prepares business, individual and trust income tax returns.
Call the office for pricing. The first consultation is free.

services.title: Tax Planning
services.summary: Strategies worked out before year end.
services.text: Planning is the key to successfully and legally reducing your tax liability. We go beyond tax compliance and proactively recommend strategies to maximize your after-tax income.
services.lead: We go beyond tax compliance. Planning is the key to legally reducing what you owe, and it works best as a conversation held before the year closes rather than after it.

covers.title: Year-round attention
covers.text: We make tax planning part of your overall financial picture rather than something that happens once a year at filing time.

covers.title: Current on the law
covers.text: We continually educate ourselves on changes to the tax law, new tax rules and the court decisions that interpret them.

covers.title: Business owners
covers.text: Perfectly legal deductions that owners commonly miss, read against how your business is actually structured.

covers.title: Individuals
covers.text: Legitimate strategies for lowering a personal tax bill, sized to your income and your circumstances.

questions.q: When should we talk about planning?
questions.a: Before year end, while there is still time to act on it. Call the office and we will set up a free initial consultation.

services.title: Tax Problems
services.summary: IRS audits, notices and unfiled returns.
services.text: We are here to help you resolve your tax problems and put an end to the misery the IRS can put you through. We pride ourselves on being efficient, affordable and discrete.
services.lead: Few things are worse than an audit letter in the mail. Rarely do our clients even have to talk with the IRS. You forward us the notice and we handle it from A to Z.

covers.title: IRS audit representation
covers.text: Audits take significant time away from your business and family. We handle the bureaucracy and the paperwork so you are not taking time off work to do it.

covers.title: Non-filed tax returns
covers.text: Getting back into the filing system, so the problem stops growing while it sits.

covers.title: Get your IRS file
covers.text: Requesting and reading what the IRS already holds on you, so a plan can be built on the real record.

questions.q: Do I have to deal with the auditor myself?
questions.a: Rarely. IRS auditors are trained to extract more information than you are legally obliged to provide, so we handle it for you.

questions.q: What should I do with an audit notice?
questions.a: Send it to us and call the office. A consultation about an audit notice is free.

services.title: Personal Financial Planning
services.summary: One-on-one guidance and a written plan.
services.text: You get one-on-one guidance and a comprehensive financial plan that helps manage risk, improve performance, and ensure the growth and longevity of your wealth.
services.lead: A plan is worth having in writing. We sit down with you one-on-one and build one that manages risk, improves performance and holds up over time.

covers.title: Managing risk
covers.text: Reading where your money is exposed and what to do about it.

covers.title: Performance
covers.text: Looking at what your assets are actually returning against what they should be.

covers.title: Growth and longevity
covers.text: Planning for the long run rather than the current year.

services.title: Estate Planning
services.summary: Wills, trusts and transfers to heirs.
services.text: The hassles and red tape associated with estate planning can be daunting, but you don't need to do it alone. Our team is waiting to assist you through every step of the process.
services.lead: Every estate planning situation is different. To help you we want to know you, your situation and the nature of your relationships, and we stay available through the whole process.

covers.title: Defining the goals
covers.text: Getting clear on what you want to happen before any document is drawn up.

covers.title: Your documents
covers.text: Preparing, organizing and reviewing current wills, trusts, health care directives and powers of attorney.

covers.title: Probate and taxes
covers.text: Decreasing the problems and expenses that come with probate, and lessening taxes at time of death.

covers.title: Transfers and liquidity
covers.text: Transferring assets to heirs the way you want, with fair and adequate liquidation to cover taxes and other expenses.

covers.title: Incapacity
covers.text: Arranging management of your estate in the event you are incapacitated, and amending the plan as circumstances change.

questions.q: Am I too young to think about this?
questions.a: In all cases estate planning ends up saving your family time, heartache and money. It is easier done early than late.

questions.q: Can you work with my attorney?
questions.a: Yes. We help organize and create your estate planning team across law, finance and taxes if you need one.

services.title: Small Business Accounting
services.summary: Monthly or quarterly books kept for you.
services.text: As a small business owner you have more important things to do than to keep your own books. We take care of your books for you, so you can get back to running your business.
services.lead: Each month or quarter we reconcile your bank account, generate an income statement and a balance sheet, and clean up your general ledger. That is the foundation the rest of your accounting sits on.
services.imageAlt: A tax statement, a pen and an open mileage log book on a desk

covers.title: Bank reconciliation
covers.text: Reconciling each month identifies lost checks and deposits, catches unjustified bank charges, and transfers the risk of a forged check back to the bank when you object promptly.

covers.title: Income statement
covers.text: An itemized profit and loss for the period, so you can see operating performance and which areas are over or under budget.

covers.title: Balance sheet
covers.text: A snapshot of the business's financial condition, and the figure a lender looks at first.

covers.title: General ledger
covers.text: Cleaning up the ledger, where an out-of-balance account is usually the first sign something has been posted wrong.

covers.title: Built out as you need it
covers.text: You can customize the package by adding payroll, tax planning, tax preparation or any of the firm's other services.

questions.a: Either. We do the same set of work on whichever cycle suits the business.

services.title: QuickBooks Services
services.text: QuickBooks is the ideal business accounting software for small to mid-sized business owners, and we set it up, train your staff on it and keep it running right.
services.lead: QuickBooks is designed for the layman, but the initial setup and installation can be tricky, and a file that was set up wrong stays wrong. We handle the whole of it.

covers.title: QuickBooks setup
covers.text: Saving hours of frustration by having us set QuickBooks up correctly the first time.

covers.title: QuickBooks training
covers.text: Once it is working properly, we train you or your employees to operate it specifically for your business.

covers.title: QuickAnswers
covers.text: Email and telephone support, so your accounting staff know the answer to a QuickBooks question is a phone call away.

covers.title: QuickTuneup
covers.text: A complete tune-up to prepare your books for tax time or a financial review, or to clean up problem areas.

covers.title: Buy QuickBooks and save
covers.text: Save up to 20% on the newest version of QuickBooks through the firm.

questions.q: Can you train my bookkeeper rather than do the work?
questions.a: Yes. Training your own employees to run QuickBooks for your business is one of the services on its own.

services.title: Assurance Services
services.text: Reviews and compilations for businesses, and audits for governmental entities, non-profit organizations and pension and profit sharing plans.
services.lead: Both partners have spent their careers in this work. The firm's accounting and auditing practice is enrolled in the AICPA Peer Review Program and is peer reviewed every three years.

covers.title: Reviews
covers.text: Analytical procedures and inquiry giving limited assurance on your financial statements, where a full audit is more than the situation calls for.

covers.title: Compilations
covers.text: Financial statements assembled from your own records, for the lender or stakeholder that asks for them.

covers.title: Governmental entities
covers.text: Audit work for governmental bodies, an area both partners have emphasised for over thirty years.

covers.title: Non-profit organizations
covers.text: Audit and review work for tax-exempt organizations, including Circular A-133 engagements.

covers.title: Pension and profit sharing plans
covers.text: Audits of employee benefit plans.

questions.a: Yes. The firm is enrolled in the AICPA Peer Review Program and has a peer review of its accounting and auditing practice every three years.

questions.q: Do you perform peer reviews for other firms?
questions.a: Yes. David A. Jentho has performed peer reviews for a number of CPA firms in Texas and is a past chairman of the AICPA Peer Review Board.

services.title: Cash Flow Management
services.summary: Projections that head off a cash crisis.
services.text: A cash crisis can be emotionally devastating. It can even kill your business. The starting point for avoiding one is allowing us to develop a cash flow projection for you.
services.lead: A profitable business can still run out of money. A projection is what turns that from a surprise into something you can see coming and plan around.

covers.title: A cash flow projection
covers.text: What is coming in and going out, far enough ahead that a shortfall is a decision rather than an emergency.

covers.title: Seasonal swings
covers.text: Planning around the months the business collects less than it spends.

covers.title: Knowing where it went
covers.text: Proper management of funds does not only save money, it makes money for you.

services.title: Bank Financing
services.summary: Loan applications a lender takes seriously.
services.text: Requesting a business loan without adequate preparation sends a clear message to the lender: high risk. It pays to be prepared and organized in your approach for financing.
services.lead: Lenders read preparation as a proxy for how the business is run. We put the numbers and the narrative together before you walk in.

covers.title: The financial package
covers.text: Statements and projections assembled in the form a loan officer expects to read them in.

covers.title: The business case
covers.text: What the money is for and how it gets repaid, set out plainly.

covers.title: Before you apply
covers.text: Finding the weak spots in the application while there is still time to address them.

services.title: Strategic Business Planning
services.summary: Getting the plan out of your head.
services.text: If you still have all your plans and ideas locked up inside your head, preparing a strategic plan can help you clarify your company's direction.
services.lead: A plan that lives only in the owner's head cannot be tested, funded or handed to anybody else. Writing it down is most of the work.

covers.title: Clarifying direction
covers.text: Putting the direction of the company into words that the people running it can act on.

covers.title: The numbers behind it
covers.text: Testing the plan against what the business can actually afford to do.

covers.title: Something to measure against
covers.text: A written plan is what makes it possible to tell later whether it worked.

services.title: Succession Planning
services.text: Developing and implementing a well-designed succession plan is essential to the survival of a family business from one generation to the next.
services.lead: Most family businesses do not survive the handover, and the reason is usually that nobody planned it. It is a long conversation, best started early.

covers.title: The transfer
covers.text: How ownership actually moves, and what it costs in tax when it does.

covers.title: The next generation
covers.text: Who runs it, and what they need to be ready to run it.

covers.title: Lifetime transfers
covers.text: Family partnerships, wealth transfers and the other structures that spread a handover over years rather than days.

services.title: New Business Formation
services.summary: Setting a new business up right.
services.text: Opening your own business is exciting. It's everything that comes after the excitement has worn off that dictates whether a small business will make it or not.
services.lead: The choices made in the first month — the entity, the registrations, the accounting system — are the ones that are expensive to change later.

covers.title: Entity selection
covers.text: Which structure fits how you intend to own and run the business, read for tax as well as liability.

covers.title: Registrations
covers.text: The federal employer identification number and setup with federal and state agencies, including payroll.

covers.title: Your accounting system
covers.text: Designing and installing a system from the start, so the first year's books are not a cleanup job.

services.title: Non-Profit Organizations
services.text: We help you set up and maintain your organization's tax-exempt status by handling all the IRS reporting for you. The IRS uses very specific revenue and expense classifications to decide whether you keep it.
services.lead: The IRS judges an exempt organization on very specific revenue and expense classifications, so it is imperative that your accounting system is built around them from the start.

covers.title: Form 990 and 990-T
covers.text: Preparing and filing the annual returns, with the income statement, balance sheet, functional expense statement, program expense statements and revenue support schedules the IRS requires.

covers.title: Applying for exempt status
covers.text: Completing and filing the 501(c)(3) application, including articles of incorporation with the exempt purpose and dissolution statements, EIN, by-laws and board minutes.

covers.title: Your accounting system
covers.text: Designing, installing and maintaining a system built around the IRS classifications, and reviewing and compiling your financial statements.

covers.title: Payroll
covers.text: Weekly, bi-weekly or monthly payroll preparation, with payroll tax preparation and deposits.

covers.title: Training
covers.text: Training for your accounting personnel, and for your board on reading non-profit financial statements and budgeting effectively.

covers.title: Churches
covers.text: Preparing the pastoral housing allowance and the other benefit documentation that meets the complex dual status of ministers.

questions.q: We are just starting out. Can you help with the application?
questions.a: Yes. If you are starting a new not-for-profit we can help prepare the 501(c)(3) application for tax-exempt status and the initial start-up documentation.

process.title: How we work
process.text: Our firm's service rests on three principles: professionalism, responsiveness and quality.

steps.title: Professionalism
steps.text: Each client receives close personal and professional attention, and is served by the expertise of the whole firm rather than one person in it.

steps.title: Responsiveness
steps.text: Companies who choose our firm rely on competent advice and fast, accurate personnel. We provide total financial services to individuals, to large and small businesses and to other agencies.

steps.title: Quality
steps.text: An accounting firm is known for the quality of its service, and our reputation reflects the high standards we demand of ourselves.

about.title: A Baytown CPA firm whose partners have practised together since 1985.
text: Ratliff & Jentho, CPAs is a full-service CPA firm licensed in Texas, working from one office on Rollingbrook Drive in Baytown. We offer a broad range of services for business owners, executives and independent professionals, and we are affordable, experienced and friendly.

Gary R. Ratliff and David A. Jentho have both been partners of the firm since 1985, each with over thirty years in public practice. Five certified public accountants work here, and every client is served by the expertise of the whole firm rather than one person in it.

Because we get new business from the people who know us best, client referrals have fuelled our growth in recent years. Through hard work we have earned the respect of the business and financial communities, and that respect illustrates our diverse talents, dedication and ability to respond quickly.

Our primary goal as a trusted advisor is to be available to provide insightful advice that lets our clients make informed financial decisions. We feel it is extremely important to continually educate ourselves professionally, to improve our technical expertise, financial knowledge and service. We will answer all of your questions as they affect both your tax and your financial situation, and we welcome you to contact us anytime.

team.name: Gary R. Ratliff, CPA
team.bio: A partner of Ratliff & Jentho, CPAs since 1985, with over thirty years in public practice. His emphasis is accounting for small businesses and auditing for governmental entities, non-profit organizations and pension and profit sharing plans, and he is experienced in taxation for corporations, partnerships, non-profits and individuals. A member of the AICPA, the Texas Society of CPAs and its Houston Chapter, he graduated in accounting from Sam Houston State University. He has been an active member of the Baytown Lions Club for many years, serving as president in 1995-1996, and has served on the boards of the Baytown Crime Stoppers Association and the Chambers County Long-term Recovery Organization, and in the past for the Baytown United Way and the Barbers Hill Athletic Booster Club.

team.name: David A. Jentho, CPA
team.bio: A partner at Ratliff & Jentho, CPAs since 1985, with over thirty years of experience emphasising accounting and auditing for governmental entities and non-profit organizations. He has performed peer reviews for a number of CPA firms in Texas. He is past chairman of the AICPA Peer Review Board, served as chairman of that board's Practice Monitoring Task Force for Circular A-133 audits, and was appointed to a three-year term on the AICPA Council as an at-large member. He has served on the Texas Society Peer Review Committee as both chairman and vice chairman, and on the Society's Professional Standards Committee. A native of Houston, he graduated in accounting from the University of Houston.

facts.heading: Privacy of your information
facts.text: The firm keeps the privacy policy required by the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act of 1999. We collect nonpublic personal information from what you give us on applications, tax organizers, worksheets and other documents, from your transactions with us, and from a consumer-reporting agency. We do not disclose it about any client or former client to anyone except as permitted by law, access is restricted to the members of the firm who need it to do your work, and we maintain physical, electronic and procedural safeguards that comply with federal regulations.

facts.heading: Careers
items: Tax Manager: a CPA licence and a minimum of five years of tax compliance work, preparing and reviewing returns for individuals and businesses, researching tax issues and developing planning strategies, and managing and coaching a team of tax professionals.

Staff Accountant: a CPA or CPA eligible, three to five years with a public accounting firm, experience preparing business, individual and trust returns, bookkeeping, financial statements and work in QuickBooks.
Both roles are on a hybrid work model with the flexibility to work from home, across the firm's Baytown and Houston offices.
